job.title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
job.pay_full: $132,100 – $178,800 a year base salary (Seattle), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: The EC2 + Networking Product BI team, part of AWS Analytics & Engineering, is the data and analytics partner for Amazon EC2, Networking Services and related Compute products, supporting 100+ product managers across 11 engagement areas. This Data Engineer owns end-to-end analytics for one or more Compute service areas: ETL pipelines, executive reports, performance callouts and deep-dive analyses that shape product roadmaps.
duties: Own the reliability and timeliness of 200+ data pipelines behind executive-facing reports, using Redshift, orchestration frameworks and AWS data services
Run Weekly and Daily Business Review reporting for EC2 services, delivered to CEO/S-Team and VP-level stakeholders
Generate callouts on service performance: week-over-week trends, anomalies and key drivers
Ingest new data sources and build metrics on usage, capacity, adoption and customer growth
Run deep dives for product managers, sales and finance, and author the SOPs behind them
Build and maintain interactive dashboards in QuickSight and Weave
Be the main analytics contact for your service areas and present findings to senior leaders
needs: 3+ years developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes, OLAP technologies, data modeling, SQL and Oracle
3+ years in the job offered or a related occupation
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics or a related field
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
nice: Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda and IAM roles and permissions
Experience with non-relational databases and data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph or column-family databases)
details.benefits: Base salary $132,100 – $178,800 a year (Seattle). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Employer entity: Amazon Development Center U.S., Inc.
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
